title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The Integrated Nutrition, Health and Food Security and Livelihood programme is implemented by Trócaire in Tobo, Heiban and Dellami counties, aims to contribute to Outcome 2.1: Poor and marginalised people, especially women and youth, have sustainable lives including diverse food sources and economic well-being. The activities and objective include, establish natural resource management groups, train groups, participatory natural resource mapping & action plans supported, support early warning, Participatory Capacity & Vulnerability Assessments etc... as necessary. So, communities are actively engaged in protecting and enhancing biodiversity/natural resources and the environment at an ecosystem level. Programmes are in partnership with, Nuba Relief, Rehabilitation and Development Organization (NRRDO). ---- The principal focus of this outcome is:- Management of natural resources to protect localbiodiversity- Community-led natural resource governance and disaster risk management processes to protect and strengthen communities’ abilities to face crisis and also to protect what they have- Natural resource management in fragile contexts is part of the nexus approach which is important for building resilience. Natural resource management is directly linked to climate adaptation as many of the impacts of climate are closely connected to changes in natural ecosystems e.g. land, water, soil, air.Capacity strengthening of communities is a core element of the approach
